messages:
Lena Morris: quick kickoff for Galileo Health onboarding. 10-min thread to align stakeholders, success criteria, and an initial 7-day run. They want Private deployment (VPC), KMS integration, and a short SOC2 evidence export. Pilot feature flag planned for 2026-06-08.

Diego Chen: I can lead infra and smoke tests. Recommend q4 quantized model for throughput. Need staging IPs and a service account to validate routes.

Asha Kapoor: I'll run enablement + prompts tuning. Propose two sessions: infra handoff (6/1 09:30 PST) and prompt tuning (6/3 10:00 PST).

Victor Reed: Galileo prefers mornings PST 6/1-6/4. Goals: 95th pct latency <220ms at pilot load, uptime >=99.9%, and evaluation pass rate >90% on sample set. Also request logs retention 30d for pilot.

Lena Morris: we can do 30d retention for pilot and provide SOC2 export. Asha, can you send invites to Victor and their PM, Nora?

Asha Kapoor: invites sent. Infra agenda (short): - allowlist & firewall checks - VPC peering walkthrough - KMS key exchange - staging cred handoff - smoke test owner & acceptance.

Diego Chen: sample smoke test I'll run after creds:
curl -X POST https://private-api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"galileo-llm-q4", "input":"health-check"}'
I'll attach a harness that asserts 95th/99th pct latencies and will add an automated rollback trigger. PR by EOD 5/28.

cs-bot: onboarding-checklist updated: infra handoff scheduled; SOC2 export queued under /onboarding/galileo/documents.

Victor Reed: clarifying acceptance gate: can brief bursts exceed 220ms if the 95th stays within target over a 30-min window? We need the exact gate for feature flag enablement.

Lena Morris: propose flag enablement criteria = 95th pct <=220ms AND error rate <=3% during a 30-min stress window at pilot load. If either fails we keep the flag off and run hosted fallback. Diego will add a 10% canary before full enable.

Diego Chen: confirmed 94 I'll add dashboards for 95/99 pct and error rate, plus canary config.

Asha Kapoor: action items: 1) Diego: infra PR + harness + rollback (due 5/28). 2) Lena: SOC2 export & docs (due 5/29). 3) Asha: calendar invites & agendas (done). 4) Victor: provide staging creds & allowlist (ASAP). Reconvene after infra handoff to validate smoke test.

Victor Reed: creds and allowlist posted to secure vault and pinged your team. Thanks :thumbsup:

Lena Morris: thanks team 94 will circulate a short recap post-infra sync and tag owners: @Diego @Asha @Victor. :white_check_mark:
